pages.title: Vitals
pages.purpose: Seven's home screen: the orb shows what Seven is doing, live processor, RAM and graphics readings with Seven's own share marked, the busiest app, today's tasks and reminders, shortcuts to every page

controls.label: Vitals
controls.description: Processor, RAM and graphics in use; the accent part of each ring is Seven's share.

controls.label: Busiest app
controls.description: The app using the most RAM right now. Hover for the top apps, Seven among them.

controls.label: Shortcuts
controls.description: Press 1 to 7 to open Dashboard, Chat, Tasks, Reminders, Memory, Settings or Guide. Press / to type to Seven in Chat.

pages.title: Home
pages.purpose: An overview of today: Seven's status, your tasks and upcoming schedules, memory, activity and your computer

controls.label: Ask Seven
controls.description: Seven is ready. Say "Hey Seven" to start.

controls.label: You're all caught up
controls.description: Say "add a task to..." to create one.

controls.label: Nothing scheduled
controls.description: Say "remind me to stretch at 4pm".

controls.label: Plan
controls.description: Invite a friend and both get a paid plan free

controls.label: What can I help with?
controls.description: Ask anything, type / for commands, or attach notes or a PDF and ask about them.

controls.label: Commands
controls.description: Runs on this computer. Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line, / for commands.

pages.title: Memory
pages.purpose: What Seven knows about you and every saved conversation, with when each was learned or said

controls.label: Facts
controls.description: Everything Seven knows about you. Search, filter by category, edit, see history or delete a fact.

controls.label: Add fact
controls.description: Tell Seven something to remember without chatting.

controls.label: Conversations
controls.description: Every chat and voice conversation with timestamps. Search all messages, export or delete one, or continue it in the Console.

controls.label: Delete a fact
controls.description: Hover a fact and press the trash icon. Seven won't bring it up again.

controls.label: Loading history
controls.description: No earlier versions. This is the first value Seven learned.

pages.title: Schedules
pages.purpose: Reminders, alarms, timers and events, grouped by day. They fire even when the app is closed

controls.label: New schedule
controls.description: Create a reminder, alarm, timer or event. Type a time like 5pm, tomorrow 9am or in 30 min.

controls.label: Repeat
controls.description: Make a schedule repeat every day, on weekdays, or on one day each week.

controls.label: Cancel a schedule
controls.description: Hover it and press the trash icon.

pages.title: Tasks
pages.purpose: Your to-do list: add tasks with a due date, priority, notes and subtasks, then tick them off

controls.label: Add a task
controls.description: Type in the box at the top and press Enter. Set a priority, due date, notes or subtasks before adding.

controls.label: Complete a task
controls.description: Tick the circle next to it. You have a few seconds to undo.

controls.label: Edit a task
controls.description: Click a task to open its notes and subtasks, or double-click the title to rename it.

pages.title: Triggers
pages.purpose: Shortcuts that launch apps, sites, files, folders, workspaces or commands from a hotkey, a voice phrase or finger snaps

controls.label: New trigger
controls.description: Pick what it does, then how to start it: a hotkey, a voice phrase or snaps.

controls.label: Test a trigger
controls.description: Hover a trigger and press the play icon.

controls.label: Workspaces
controls.description: Save the apps and windows you have open, then restore them in one step.

controls.label: Ask about it in a chat
Bring your study material
controls.description: Notes, textbooks, slides or sheets. Seven reads them here on this computer and answers your questions with page numbers.

controls.label: Choose files
controls.description: or drop them here · PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, TXT, MD · up to 50 MB

pages.title: Settings
pages.purpose: Everything you can configure: your profile and plan, the brain (model, personality, answers), voice, privacy and data, and system options

controls.label: Profile
controls.description: How Seven addresses you, and the email linked to your license.

controls.label: Current plan
controls.description: Facts and conversation history are unlimited on every plan.

controls.label: Referrals
controls.description: When a friend you invite uses Seven for 7 hours, they get Pro and you get Ultimate, each free for one month.

controls.label: Your code
controls.description: Copying includes a short message and the download link.

controls.label: Model
controls.description: The language model that writes Seven's replies, running on this computer through Ollama. Bigger models are smarter and need more memory.

controls.label: Personality
controls.description: Tone only. These never change facts, actions or what Seven is allowed to do.

controls.label: Honesty
controls.description: How directly Seven tells you when you're wrong.

controls.label: Humor
controls.description: How dry and witty Seven sounds.

controls.label: Temperature
controls.description: Lower is more precise and repeatable; higher is more varied. Factual answers are always kept low.

controls.label: Stream replies
controls.description: Show and speak the answer as it's written. Off waits for the full reply before speaking.

controls.label: Follow-up questions
controls.description: How often Seven asks you something back to understand you better.

controls.label: Model for hard questions
controls.description: Optional. Used only for questions that need deeper reasoning.

controls.label: Conversation context
controls.description: How far back Seven reads the current chat when it replies.

controls.label: Reference memory
controls.description: How long "open the second one" or "do it again" still refers to your last action.

controls.label: Results per search
controls.description: Fewer results are faster to read out.

controls.label: Open the best match
controls.description: Open the top result right away. Off lists results and waits for you to choose.

controls.label: Search inside documents
controls.description: Match words inside PDF and Word files, not only file names.

controls.label: Open unknown apps as websites
controls.description: If an app isn't installed, try its website instead.

controls.label: Online features
controls.description: Seven's language model always runs on this computer. These are the only things that use the internet.

controls.label: Web search
controls.description: Look up live information such as news and weather. Only the search text is sent to the search provider.

controls.label: Usage statistics
controls.description: Send a device id, your email if you added one, your country and how long Seven is active. Conversations and memories are never sent.

controls.label: Check for updates
controls.description: Ask GitHub once a day whether a new version of Seven is available.

controls.label: Your memory
controls.description: Facts and conversations are stored only on this computer.

controls.label: Backup
controls.description: A single JSON file with your facts, conversations, schedules, tasks, triggers and workspaces.

controls.label: Export
controls.description: Save a copy you can restore on this or another computer.

controls.label: Import
controls.description: Adds the backup to what you already have. Nothing is replaced.

controls.label: Delete everything Seven remembers
controls.description: Every fact, conversation, goal and learned preference. This can't be undone, so download a backup first.

controls.label: This computer
controls.description: Live hardware readings. Seven uses the same values when you ask about your PC.

controls.label: Memory
controls.description: available

controls.label: Voice bar
controls.description: Live captions of what you said and what Seven is saying, at the top centre of your screen.

controls.label: Task panel shortcut
controls.description: Opens the floating task panel from anywhere in Windows.

controls.label: Reinstall missing components
controls.description: Runs setup again to fix the AI engine, models or dependencies. Your memory, tasks, schedules and triggers are kept.

controls.label: Appearance
controls.description: Choose how Seven looks. Match Windows follows your Windows light or dark setting.

controls.label: Keep listening after a reply
controls.description: For 8 seconds after Seven answers, reply without saying its name.

controls.label: Snaps and claps
controls.description: Triggers you start with a snap. Typing and mouse clicks never count.

controls.label: Control words
controls.description: Phrases that change how Seven listens. Say them at any time.

controls.label: Speech recognition
controls.description: How Seven turns your voice into text. Separate from the model that writes replies. Larger models make fewer mistakes but are slower without a graphics card.

controls.label: Only respond to my voice
controls.description: Seven will recognise your voice and ignore everyone else. Voiceprints will stay on this PC.

controls.label: Respond only to my voice
controls.description: Coming in an upcoming version. Until then, the wake word keeps others from triggering Seven.

controls.label: Compare plans
controls.description: Limits for schedules, triggers, knowledge files and more on each plan.

controls.label: Activate a license key
controls.description: Paste the key from your purchase email.

controls.label: Start trial
controls.description: Try Pro free for 14 days.

controls.label: Try Pro free for 14 days
controls.description: No payment needed. Your plan returns to Free when the trial ends.

pages.title: Guide
pages.purpose: Learn how to use Seven: try live commands, see everything Seven can do with example phrases, set it up, privacy facts, questions and shortcuts

controls.label: Try it now
controls.description: Run real commands like max brightness or open Chrome with one click.

controls.label: What Seven can do
controls.description: Every ability with phrases you can say or type.

controls.label: Set up Seven
controls.description: A short checklist: your name, your voice, a workspace, a trigger and your documents.

controls.label: Questions
controls.description: Answers about privacy, the internet, models and troubleshooting.

controls.label: ], [MessageSquare, 'Chat',
controls.description: Type anything, the same as speaking. Seven shows what it did after each reply, and chats are saved so you can pick them up later.

pages.title: Feedback
pages.purpose: Report a bug, request a feature or tell the team what to improve

controls.label: How bad is it?
controls.description: Critical means a crash or lost data.

controls.label: Email
controls.description: Optional. Only if you'd like a reply.

controls.label: Include app details
controls.description: Adds your Seven version and Windows version so bugs are easier to reproduce. Nothing else is sent.

pages.title: Updates
pages.purpose: Check for a new version of Seven, see what changed, download it and install it

controls.label: Check for updates automatically
controls.description: Seven checks shortly after it starts and every two hours, and tells you when a new version is ready.

controls.label: Download in the background
controls.description: This release downloads by itself. You choose when to install.
